docs.message:
docs: lernapps.net serves a copy of every listed app (KD-21)

## Intent

"The app stays its creator's, at their own address" does not hold together with data protection (lernapps/apps#58): whoever hosts the app is the provider schools must answer to. lernapps.net serves a copy of every listed app instead, already in the first draft. The creator stays the author and keeps licence, repository and address.

## Key changes

- pdt42: the infrastructure (D1), the frontend-only asset and the data protection moat (E3), "List an app" and its channels (D5), with "accesses only its own data" in the fitness signal, all three experiences (D7), and the first draft (D8) with the new riskiest assumption a-creators-accept-copy.
- The creators' value proposition: list in minutes without answering to schools for data protection yourself.
- biz42: hosting moves into scope, the risks name lernapps.net as provider, and a new capability cap-hosting is required by obj-first-apps.
- vision.md: "The creator stays the author".
- The plan records KD-21.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The check own-data-only follows in tooling (8356d57); the copies themselves in apps (880b129) and tooling (7dbcb8a).
